fusions.name: Shut the Lid
fusions.desc: Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health, a threshold that rises with each rank. The blow deals 20 damage, consumes every affliction on the target, adding 1.4 times their remaining damage, and leaves it [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Narrowing Bars
fusions.desc: A ring of barbed bars swings in around you and deals 4 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles, with a 35% chance to leave each [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: The Closing Grate
fusions.desc: Drives a stake into the ground ahead of you and draws a ring of bars 6 tiles across in toward it for 5 seconds, dragging every enemy near it inward. Anything it catches moves 25% slower for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Nowhere to Turn
fusions.desc: Against an enemy carrying one of your afflictions, your damage rises 12%.
